verdict.rationale: Vast.ai is a GPU compute marketplace, not a SaaS/API product with a distinct 'production' data environment vs. a sandbox/test mode; the evidence never frames the platform in terms of separating sandbox from production data, since each rented instance is simply an isolated compute unit under the customer's own control. This story's axis (sandbox testing without touching production data) doesn't map onto a bare-metal/GPU rental marketplace's product model.
